Prospective paper record (idx-signals/paper/ledger.jsonl, 105 chained lines, 2026-10-07..10-14): 17 SCAN (IDX 5 sessions 10-07/08/09/12/13; US 5 same sessions; CRYPTO 7 UTC days 10-07..10-13), 87 DECISION (IDX 23 = 21 PASS + 2 NOT EXECUTABLE; US 49 PASS; CRYPTO 15 PASS; BUY ON TRIGGER 0), 1 OUTCOME (CRYPTO MET, signal 10-07, scored 2026-10-14T00:27:49Z: r5max -0.74%, E30/E50/E100 all false, plan trade net -16.99%, verdict CORRECT REJECTION). The r5max "distribution" is a single point; nothing can be said about it yet.
Why every candidate PASSes on HEAD (idxsig/paper.py decide(), lines 450-484): BUY needs (a) detection gate p_one_sided_vs_matched < 0.05 and lift > 1 (all three detectors pass: p = 0.004975 = 1/201, lifts 9.32 IDX / 5.42 US / 4.64 CRYPTO) AND (b) trading gate trading.p_one_sided < 0.05 on the harness run that validation_evidence() picks, which is the LAST run in results/RUNS.jsonl matching rule_id + 2023 window + "Selected: <sel>" (loop at lines 846-860 has no break). Every such run has p = 1.0 (IDX, CRYPTO) or 0.622 (US) with negative average net, so PASS. The cited run drifted as runs were appended: IDX 20261008T000401Z (-4.06% vs -0.53%, 407 scored, fill A) on 10-07/08 then 20261009T050040Z (-3.64% vs -0.44%, 251 scored, fill C) from 10-09; US 20261008T060443Z (-3.65% vs -0.60%, 1099 scored) on 10-07 then 20261008T115656Z (-0.97% vs -0.75%, p 0.622, 536 scored, 876 signals, fill B, quarantine unit_schedule) from 10-08; CRYPTO constant 20261008T005732Z (-1.90% vs +1.42%, 264 scored).
APPROVAL-v2 exists only on PR #3 (origin/claude/us-pipeline-v1 paper.py ~lines 863-953): approval() requires, in order, detection p<0.05 & lift>1; a pin in APPROVAL_PINS for the market; the pinned run present with config_sha256 equal to the pin; pin.execution == PLAN_EXECUTION[market]; trading p<0.05; average net > 0; average net > matched baseline. Pins: IDX 20261008T000401Z (config 34a0d8d7...), CRYPTO 20261008T005732Z (config 86bd8d48...), US None. Under it today US fails "no evidence run is pinned ... EXEC-US-v1"; IDX/CRYPTO fail first on the execution-string mismatch ("idxsig-harness: entry at the next close..." vs "paper-score-v3 with the v4 entry band") and would fail p/avg/baseline anyway. PR #3 also names its policy PAPER-POLICY-v4 (2026-10-09, 5% stop rule, EXEC-US-v1, paper-score-v4), colliding with HEAD's PAPER-POLICY-v4 (2026-10-13, E3 rule) under which 2 scans + 16 decisions are already recorded; its merge-base c09a27a predates PR #6, it rewrites 578 lines of paper.py and lacks moonshot_e3.py, so it cannot merge as is.
PAPER-POLICY-v4 on HEAD (E3 rule) is dormant: e3_plan() (lines 124-141) returns None unless rules/moonshot_e3.SELECTED is set AND research/E3/validation/result.json exists with passed=true and matching selected. SELECTED is None (moonshot_e3.py line 25) and research/E3/validation/ does not exist. E3 discovery (2021-01-22..2022-12-30, 108 detector x plan pairs, fill model C) admitted 0: 18 pairs avg>0, 3 beat matched random at p<0.05, 0 positive in 2022; validation was never run. If a pair were validated, IDX scans would switch to MOONSHOT_E3_D1, decisions would carry the plan (entry rule/window, exit rule, hold, no chase), and outcomes would be produced by _score_plan via execution.execute.
First real prospective outcome evidence: CRYPTO started 2026-10-14 (MET); OGN due 10-15, four 10-09 signals due 10-16, all 15 current crypto decisions scorable by 10-21 (due() needs 7 calendar days). IDX and US: due() needs 6 weekdays after the signal, so the 10-07 cohort (IDX 4, US 7) becomes scorable on 2026-10-15 after each market's close; 10-08 cohort 10-16; 10-09 cohort 10-19; 10-12 cohort 10-20; 10-13 cohort 10-21. The repo contains no scheduler (only .github/workflows/checks.yml CI); routine times are inferred from commits (IDX ~10:26 UTC, US ~22:53 UTC, CRYPTO ~00:25 UTC, crypto score 2 min after its scan). Whether the IDX/US routines invoke paper-score is unknown from the repo.
Sample size implied by the scans: IDX 23 candidates / 5 sessions = 4.6 per session (3-7), 18 unique names (TFCO x3, BIKE x3, GTBO x2 are consecutive ARA locks), i.e. roughly 95 decisions (~75 unique) per ~20.5-session month on an eligible universe of ~825-832; US 49/5 = 9.8 per session (7-15), 41 unique, roughly 200/month on ~5,580-5,610 eligible; CRYPTO 15/7 = 2.14 per day (1-4), 13 unique, roughly 65/month on 478-481 eligible. Consecutive-day repeats overlap in their 5-session windows, so effective n is lower than the count.
Detector identity in every record: IDX MOONSHOT_E1_D1 v1.1 selected F1_ARA (rules/moonshot_e1.py sha 425684b7..., benchmarks F2_IGNITION_D, F1_ARA); US MOONSHOT_E2_US_D1 v1 G2_RET30 and CRYPTO MOONSHOT_E2_CRYPTO_D1 v1 G2_RET30 (rules/moonshot_g.py sha b050c4d3..., benchmarks G5_IGNITION_D, G1_RET20_CLOSEHIGH). Sample-size arithmetic (not a forecast): at the observed rates a month yields about 95 IDX, 200 US and 65 CRYPTO discovery outcomes; a binomial 95% half-width at those n and the validation precisions is about 8 pp (IDX, n 90, p 0.18), 5 pp (US, n 200, p 0.154) and 9 pp (CRYPTO, n 65, p 0.185), before any reduction for overlapping consecutive-day repeats.
constraints: Read-only session: nothing in /home/user/KOD-Machine may be modified; ledger is append-only and CI (tools/check_append_only.py --all in .github/workflows/checks.yml) rejects any edit of past records; paper.append() refuses on a broken chain.

Holdout sealed: IDX 2024-01-02..2025-02-21, US/CRYPTO 2024 onward (research/E3/protocol.json periods.holdout; backtest.HOLDOUT refuses detector windows touching it unless --holdout-final). Nothing may be read or computed on it.

No re-tuning of frozen detectors on data whose outcomes were seen: research/E3/REPORT.md 'Re-tuning thresholds on the same discovery data, or relaxing the admission rule after reading this table, would be selection on noise and is not done'; E3 plan family is exhausted for F1/F7/F8. A new family needs a new protocol frozen before analysis, designed without looking at 2023, tested once on it.

Policy identity: any change to Policy fields, PREPROCESSING, or (on PR #3) APPROVAL_PINS is a new POLICY_ID with a new policy_sha (paper.py lines 65-69, 78; PR #3 README line 50-51); decisions keep the policy they were made under.

Paper BUY on HEAD requires detection p<0.05 & lift>1 AND trading p_one_sided<0.05 on the harness run over the fixed 2023 validation window (VALIDATION_WINDOWS, paper.py lines 821-823); under PR #3 additionally a pinned run with matching config sha, matching execution, average net > 0 and > matched baseline.

Detector module contract: a rule module may import nothing from the package (moonshot_e3.py docstring), must pass the causal-source audit (`python -m idxsig rules` in CI) and expose features()/family_flags()/FAMILY with the feature keys scan_frame reads; it must be listed in rules/__init__.registry() for harness runs and in paper._detector() to be scanned.

validation_evidence() hardcodes the detection result paths (research/E1/validation/result.json; research/E2/<market>/validation/result.json) and requires res['rule'] == selected plus an 'E30' block with precision, precision_lo95/hi95, base_rate, lift_vs_base, lift_vs_matched_random, p_one_sided_vs_matched.

E3-style admission for any (detector, plan) pair: discovery scored >= 200, avg net > 0, one-sided p < 0.05 vs matched random (200 draws, floor 0.005), avg net > 0 in every discovery year with >= 50 scored; validation: scored >= 100, avg > 0, p < 0.05 (research/E3/protocol.json).

Execution model constraints baked into decide(): IDX entry next close, chase <= close x 1.10, stop 5-15% below close, Rp50 floor, lot 100; US entry next open; CRYPTO entry at the decision-time Binance quote, no quote = NOT EXECUTABLE; hypothetical equity Rp100m / $10,000 / 10,000 USDT; horizon 5 sessions; decide() is long-only.
No real orders and no ASTRA/production changes; paper.py docstring 'No orders, ever'.
PR #3 cannot be merged onto HEAD as is: PAPER-POLICY-v4 id collision with records already in the ledger, and it lacks moonshot_e3.py / the E3 hook.
gaps: Prospective outcome evidence is one record (CRYPTO MET). The r5max distribution, E30/E50/E100 rates and decision verdicts for IDX and US are unknown until 2026-10-15 at the earliest; the first full cohorts complete around 10-21.

Unknown whether the IDX and US routines run paper-score after paper-scan; the schedule is not in the repository (only CI in .github/workflows/checks.yml). The CRYPTO routine evidently does (score commit two minutes after the scan).

Provenance of US evidence run 20261008T115656Z (876 signals, 536 scored, -0.97% vs -0.75%, p 0.622) is not described in research/E2/repair_v2/REVIEW.md, which reports 113137Z and 113335Z (683 signals). What changed in the quarantine between code d97cc1d and 5fe491b to add 193 signals is not documented in the files read.

On HEAD the trading evidence cited in live decisions is 'last matching run in RUNS.jsonl', so it has already changed twice (IDX on 10-09, US on 10-08) without a policy version change; APPROVAL_PINS exist only on the unmerged PR #3.
IDX exchange holidays are not modelled (_next_session docstring, paper.py lines 330-331); the due-date arithmetic above assumes weekdays only and _window_complete will simply wait for bars.

US outcomes depend on scoring_units(): any provider split record after the signal must be corroborated by an SEC filing (us-actions-v2) or the OUTCOME is UNSCORABLE; the share of the 49 US decisions that will be scorable is unknown.
Effective sample size: repeated names on consecutive days (IDX TFCO/BIKE/GTBO, US 8 names, CRYPTO 2) have overlapping 5-session windows; no independence correction exists in the scorer.
E3 validation was never run (no selected pair), so PAPER-POLICY-v4's E3 branch (_score_plan, plan-carrying decisions) has only unit-test coverage (tests/test_paper_v4.py), no ledger record.
E4 (PR #7) short-side family failed v2 validation (34 scored, avg -1.50%); the exact v2 discovery table and the v1 results were not read here beyond the commit messages and module header.

No prospective record exists for the E1 benchmark F2_IGNITION_D or E2 benchmarks G5/G1 beyond their flag lists in SCAN records (BENCHMARKS are 'logged every scan, never decided on'); their prospective E30 rates would require scoring code that does not exist.

The SCAN record's 'eligible' universe for IDX (~830 of 920) excludes names with <= 20 sessions of history (MIN_HISTORY) or not tradeable; the exact composition of the 90 non-fresh names per IDX scan was not inspected.
